row.body: I saved the cloth with red grit for you. The pasture study crew passed the first hot day; the flies vanished, and afterward a patrol turned us back.
row.title: the first hot day — red grit

sidecar.gloss: A personal trace connects a farm trial to symptoms before a later restriction.
sidecar.rival_reading: Emergency workers could have picked up the same red grit while responding near a field; this personal trace does not prove the trial caused the emergency.
